evidence_level: L3 static (editor.exe) + L1/L2 full-archive vectorized validation; L4=0
address_convention: PE file offsets in field_map.json (matching t79); exact VAs, raw instruction bytes, and Capstone disassembly for every gate/handler/sink/fixup are recorded in xref_{award,language,weather,derby,media}.json.

summary.xml_denominator_note: reports/xml_denominator_coverage.json covers club/comp/nation (1,034 occ) only; these 5 tables' 188-field XML denominator is counted directly from MANIFEST-verified master.json.

reconciliations.finding: BOTH t01l(E27) and t76c(E118) swapped precipitation and wind blocks in weather(27). Quadruple static proof (WEATHER::read 0x158ba47..0x158bb79, WEATHER::get 0x158e7d1..0x158ec90, WEATHER_SEASON::get 0x158f28e/30c/780..a19, WEATHER::set 0x15902c5..0x1590b77) proves blk+2..6 (+0x02..+0x06) = w{b}w0..w4 (WIND) and blk+7..11 (+0x07..+0x0b) = w{b}p0..p4 (PRECIPITATION). Normalizer 0x43e7e10 fixes +0x02 (76 non-100 blocks = wind) and +0x07 (67 non-100 blocks = precip).

t76c L2 split blk+0..1 into 1B w{b}sd + 1B w{b}dn ({0,1}) and left blk+22 ({0,100}) unassigned. L3 static proves blk+0..1 (+0x00) is a 2B i16 w{b}sd (0..359) and blk+22 (+0x16) is w{b}dn ('tend') with 0x64 (100) as explicit NULL sentinel (WEATHER_SEASON::get 0x158f3e5, WEATHER::set 0x1590498/a2f/a5b/a87).

DERBY::read (0x3d00950) always reads 4 lstrings (Dnam, Dsnm, Dasn, Danm); Dtm1/Dtm2 bind [db+0x98]=table_24 TEAM (not table_3 CLUB) via 0x3bf3460 and emit 'Ttea'; server-only 6B block gated at 0x3d00aae is D1tw@s28, D1td@s30, D1tl@s32; trailing pairs are Dfg1@c28/s34, Dfg2@c29/s35, Dwdr@c34/s40, Dntr@c35/s41 (correcting off-by-2 '36' typo in slots_client_18.json).

MEDIA_SOURCE::read (0x15457c0) closes 208/208 rows on BOTH client (36,824B) and server (38,280B). Server-only block at 0x1545cfe = 1B Mper + 1B Mscp + 4B Mdlp + u8 cnt_jor(=0) = exactly +7B/row. Mcli stores 8B CLUB (duni,rdui) UID pairs (450/450 in table_3 UIDs) + lstr curl. t74's 16 distinct 5B-before-identity prefixes = u32(cnt_lnm=0 or last Mlnm ordinal) + u8(Mapc).

Consistent with E20/E117/E120: fm24_dump 'award.rdui@64' and 'language.rdui_suffix@17' point to row ordinal (+0x08), whereas native rdui (+0x10) sits at @72 / suf+25 (equal to duni on 100% of rows and suppressed by DATABASE_RECORD::get 0xfe38a2 -> held).

preserved_negatives: t57/t63 negative results on club/comp/nation main rows untouched (out of t83 scope).

17 xml fields across the 5 tables remain held with explicit first_counterexample (rdui x5, AWty/AWdr/AWxa/AWfo/AWsc/AWbr, Lfam/Lgro/Lsub, Mper/Mscp/Mdlp); candidates/violations are never promoted to L3.
AWna/AWsn (award language layer) are non-wire in table_0.dat; AWsh is subtable-backed in table_12.dat.
